metadata.name: Beach Volleyball Statistics
metadata.subtitle: Scores, rankings & match stats
metadata.promotional_text: Follow your beach volleyball results, compare player rankings, and keep your games and stats together.
metadata.description:
Track beach volleyball games, rankings, and player statistics in one place.

Browse public game results and ratings, or sign in to keep your own players and results. Record doubles and one-on-one games, explore player records, and choose the stats you want to include.

Features include:
• Game scores and history
• Player rankings and statistics
• Season and game-format filters
• Personal game entry and player profiles
• Optional AI recaps and shareable flyers
• Privacy choices, content reporting, and author blocking

AI features ask permission before sending selected information and photos to OpenAI. Browsing and ordinary score recording remain available without that permission.

Beach Volleyball Statistics connects to the stats website. Internet access is required for sign-in, syncing, and AI features.
